data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 (async post-call mutation) contradicts SRC_005 (sync pre-call lease-mismatch): SRC_004 requires evaluating a mutation that moves validation after the provider call, while SRC_005 requires the refusal to occur before the provider call. Both are enforced by program eval under minimal frozen fixtures. The contradiction is refuted if the firewall can enforce synchronous pre-checks and detect post-call mutations under the same minimal fixture without invoking the provider, or if SRC_004's counterconditions overlap with SRC_005's synchronous precondition rather than negating it.
